scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to finite connected threshold graphs and ordinary closed-neighborhood identifying codes. The proof is structural; exhaustive computation through order 10 is corroborative only. Literature searches found no matching threshold-graph all-code classification, but indexing is imperfect and some older split-graph material was not fully searchable, so residual bibliographic risk is stated rather than converted into a novelty claim.
title: All identifying codes of connected threshold graphs
